title: NASA-UAP-D6, Apollo 17 Technical Crew Debriefing, 1973
doc_notes: This document is an excerpt from the Apollo 17 Technical Crew Debriefing held on January 4, 1973, containing reports of light flashes observed by astronauts during the mission.

incidents.summary: Astronaut Harrison Schmitt reported seeing light flashes continuously during the Apollo 17 flight while dark adapted.
Astronaut Harrison Schmitt observed a potential light flash on the lunar surface.
incidents.quote: I had one which I thought was a flash on the lunar surface.
